g.text: Fleet — Relationships: an actor IS its contracts (the posture on each edge)

text.tspan: An actor is its relationships, not its file. Swap the person or implementation behind a box and the edges — the contracts — still hold; that is what makes it an actor.
The SC is a person too; Claude plays Planner / Handler / Operator / Supervisor.
The Operator and Supervisor never talk directly — those hops are relayed by the Handler's Router (see the orchestration view).
The SDLC parallel: each edge is a seat a different person could fill — analyst, builder, reviewer — defined by the contract, not the individual.
hold the goal — don't guess it, don't hand it back;
the decision and the accountability are the SC's
give true intel, never a guess as fact

g.text: output goes to an independent check
verdict — but the Handler owns the pass
